name: juicy-llm
description: LLM-powered text utilities — translate, fix spelling, OCR, custom prompts
author: juicyjusung

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
scripts.publish: mv .claude /tmp/.claude-juicy-bak 2>/dev/null; bunx @raycast/api@latest publish; EXIT=$?; mv /tmp/.claude-juicy-bak .claude 2>/dev/null; exit $EXIT

commands.name: fix-spelling
commands.title: Fix Spelling
commands.description: Fix spelling and spacing in selected text

commands.name: custom-prompts
commands.title: Custom Prompts
commands.description: Run custom LLM prompts on selected text

commands.name: manage-model-presets
commands.title: Manage Model Presets
commands.description: Create and manage LLM model presets

commands.name: manage-providers
commands.title: Manage Providers
commands.description: Configure LLM provider API keys and settings

commands.name: view-history
commands.title: View History
commands.description: View and search LLM execution history

title: Juicy LLM
